description: 80-dps Wave-3 full periodic table nuclear binding synthesis probe across all 3,558 AME2020 nuclides (Z = 0..118, A = 1..295; 3,556 with A >= 2) loaded directly from computations/data/ame2020.json, unifying 3D compact-ball simplicial manifold triangulations (3D FCC nearest-neighbor clique ball, coordinate-verified 3D Freudenthal-Kuhn lattice ball, and 3D close-packed Mackay shell ball), H_3 and H_4 GPMT 3-/4-body cumulants, 3D harmonic-oscillator + Mayer-Jensen spin-orbit (2j+1) shell closures, Compton Fermi symmetry energy, proved Temperley-Lieb seniority pairing (tlPairingGap), and 3D FCC proton-pair Coulomb repulsion (continuum spherical and Lane-N4 isospin-symmetrized discrete pair sum) across q_0 = q_at(95) (1-term proton pin), q_2t = q_two_term_borromean_at(95) (2-term Borromean V^3 QED proton pin), and q_muon = q_muon_at(95) (ideal muon pin). Zero fitted parameters, zero float64 intermediates.
caveats: Branch definitions and anti-double-counting discipline: (1) Primary Wave-3 branches use the Lean-proved Temperley-Lieb singlet pairing gap delta_TL_univ = (1/2) * w3_GPMT * [2]_q = E_0 / (2 * [3]_q) = 0.68764544 MeV (SeniorityPairingAndHoyleTriadThreshold.tlPairingGap); the single secondary branch W3_Shell_SymHO_FermiSym_H4_AsqrtPair_logD evaluates the empirical-style +/- b_2 / sqrt(A) scaling for comparison. (2) To avoid double-counting Pauli isospin asymmetry, W3_Shell_HO_Pure_H4_logD subtracts only the pure (Z, N) 3D harmonic-oscillator excitation energy E_kin_ho_pure(Z, N) = (N_osc_pure(Z) + N_osc_pure(N)) * E_0 * A^{-1/3} (with zero extra -E_sym_compton and zero unproved -3/4 CoM offset), whereas W3_Shell_SymHO_FermiSym_H4_logD/BorD/DiscC subtract the isospin-symmetric 3D HO baseline E_kin_ho_sym(A) = N_osc_sym(A) * E_0 * A^{-1/3} plus the parameter-free Compton Fermi symmetry energy E_sym_compton(Z, N) = a_sym * (N - Z)^2 / A. W3_Kuhn_PauliCore_H4_logD and W3_Shell_PauliCore_H4_logD enforce Pauli isospin balance combinatorially via the Pauli-capped complex (A_core = 2 * min(Z, N) + D surface triangles) with zero extra -E_sym_compton subtraction. (3) W3_Shell_SymHO_FermiSym_H4_DiscC_logD uses the exact Lane-N4 (SimplicialCoulombGraphMetricDerivation) isospin-symmetrized discrete 3D FCC Coulomb energy E_C_disc_sym(Z, A) = (alpha * hbar * c / l_bond) * (Z(Z - 1) / (A(A - 1))) * S_FCC(A). (4) Isobaric beta-stability predictions Z_*(A) use QOU's own parameter-free two-term nucleon mass splitting (m_n - m_p)_QOU(q) = Q_beta^{N=2,2t}(q) + m_e.
